## SecurityAssetTermsFieldSnapshot

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Application.SecurityMaster.SecurityAssetTermsFieldSnapshot</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityAssetTermsFieldSnapshot.cs:25](../../../../src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityAssetTermsFieldSnapshot.cs#L25).

A canonical snapshot of every stored key an approved assetSpecificTerms.* field edit would overwrite when ApprovedFieldEditCanonicalMergeHandler merges it. The snapshot is taken at staging and recorded on the revision as its base, then taken again at publish. If the two differ, the canonical field changed after the proposal was drafted, and publishing it would silently overwrite that newer value.

The declared mode of the calculated projection (ADR-025): a record whose declared schedule conventions ScheduleSpecFactory maps to a ScheduleSpec projects the periods ScheduleGenerator generates, accrues each through ScheduleDayCount with its period context, and carries StructuredCashFlowScheduleEvidence. Coupon, face, factor and day count still come from StructuredCashFlowTermsResolver. Explicit principal rows retain their cash dates; otherwise principal follows the bullet, sinker and asserted-bullet rules of the legacy walk.

## SecurityMasterConflictAuthorityPolicy

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Application.SecurityMaster.SecurityMasterConflictAuthorityPolicy</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterConflictAuthorityPolicy.cs:18](../../../../src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterConflictAuthorityPolicy.cs#L18).

Deterministic conflict-authority policy. Selects the default winner from the precedence ladder: golden-copy source (the configured authority) wins outright; otherwise the higher-ranked source in SourcePrecedence wins; otherwise (equal rank) the fresher source (by FreshnessAsOf) wins; otherwise the higher confidence score wins. Bulk eligibility is derived from the structured Recommendation: equivalent dismissals stay eligible regardless of winner, while accept-winner/accept-challenger recommendations stay eligible only when the policy winner matches the recommended source (otherwise they fall back to per-row review).

Source: [src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterCsvParser.cs:20](../../../../src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterCsvParser.cs#L20).

Parses CSV files for Security Master bulk import. Expected header columns (case-insensitive): Ticker, Name, AssetClass, Currency, Exchange, ISIN, CUSIP, FIGI The accepted asset classes are DERIVED from SecurityAssetClassCatalog.IdentifierOnlyImportableAssetClasses rather than kept in a private table here: a CSV row carries identity only, so it can create exactly the classes whose asset-specific terms are all optional. A class with a required term (an option&#x27;s strike, a bond&#x27;s maturity) is refused with a message that says so, because the alternative — defaulting the term — would mint a governed record on an economic fact nobody supplied.

## SecurityMasterProjectionWarmupService

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Application.SecurityMaster.SecurityMasterProjectionWarmupService</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterProjectionWarmupService.cs:21](../../../../src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterProjectionWarmupService.cs#L21).

Hosted service that warms the in-memory projection cache on startup when SecurityMasterOptions.PreloadProjectionCache is enabled. This eliminates cold-start latency for the first queries after deployment. When SecurityMasterOptions.ProjectionCacheRefreshMinutes is positive, the service also re-warms the cache on that interval (the cache&#x27;s atomic ReplaceAll swap keeps concurrent readers on a complete set throughout). Cross-node coherence is primarily delivered by SecurityMasterProjectionChangeListener (PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY); the periodic re-warm is the backstop that bounds staleness if a notification is lost or the listener is disabled. Identifier validity boundaries always schedule a reseed, independently of periodic cache warming and notifications, so clock-only activation and expiry reach the live registry.

## SecurityMasterWorkbenchCommandService

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Application.SecurityMaster.SecurityMasterWorkbenchCommandService</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterWorkbenchCommandService.cs:37](../../../../src/Meridian.Application/SecurityMaster/SecurityMasterWorkbenchCommandService.cs#L37).

Phase 2 governed write surface for the Security Master Passport Workbench. UpdateSecurityFieldAsync — justification-gated operator field edits staged as overlay annotations in IOperatorOverridesStore. The passport-displayed security version is an optimistic-concurrency staleness guard (a stale ExpectedVersion surfaces as SecurityMasterConcurrencyException → HTTP 409). Overlay edits are deliberately NOT appended to the economic event stream: that stream is replayed verbatim to rebuild the passport, so a partial field-edit payload would corrupt the economic definition. ResolveSourceConflictAsync — scored by the conflict-authority policy, enforces acknowledged deviation, and closes the underlying conflict via ISecurityMasterConflictService with an atomic open→resolved transition; a concurrent duplicate resolution surfaces as SecurityMasterConcurrencyException rather than silently overwriting the first operator&#x27;s winner. SubmitForApprovalAsync / ApproveRevisionAsync — route through the IOperationsContinuityWorkflowService approval gate and advance the durable ISecurityMasterRevisionStore lifecycle (Draft → Submitted → Approved) with compare-and-set transitions. PublishRevisionAsync — refuses to publish unless the revision is durably Approved, fans out to the ordered ISecurityMasterRevisionPublishedHandler seam (Phase 3 supplies handlers), and surfaces any handler failure (SecurityMasterPublishFailedException) leaving the revision Approved for an idempotent retry; only an all-success fan-out transitions the revision to Published.
